title: Procurify
subtitle: Software Engineer Intern · Vancouver, BC
summary: Faster exports, lower memory use, and more reliable integration workflows, alongside customer-facing React features.

sections.title: Faster exports
sections.body: Cut database calls by **99% (3,200+ to 14)** and request latency by **25%** by removing N+1 SQL queries and introducing batched data retrieval.

sections.title: Audit history at lower cost
sections.body: Reduced peak memory use by **84% (1.55 GB to 253 MB)** in the audit-log version-history pipeline by restructuring version-history construction around ID-based batching.

sections.title: Reliable updates
sections.body: Eliminated a race condition in integration-status updates through row-level locking with PonyORM’s `get_for_update()`.

sections.title: Customer-facing features
sections.body: Shipped React features and supporting APIs for account management and troubleshooting, collaborating with senior engineers, product, and design.
